oneliner.t: No Labels Party nominee (coded I) and physics-trained educator who won the No Labels primary unopposed with 571 votes; the party did not endorse him. He ran for this seat as the Green nominee in 2024 (2.5%), and earlier ran as a Republican for the state House (2012) and for the Phoenix Union school board (2022).

profile.residence: Phoenix area, AZ (inferred from 2022 Phoenix Union school-board run; current residence not documented)

upbringing.t: Ballotpedia, his only biographical source found, lists Ashland, Oregon as his birthplace and a 2008 University of Arizona B.S. in physics and astronomy (minors in math and Italian). He says he was drawn to teaching as a teaching assistant and has taught physics and computer programming in classrooms and online; in 2023 he described himself as a middle-school science teacher.

platform.t: Holds that life begins at conception (2022 and 2024 surveys); listed Randall Terry's website as a source in 2024.
Parents are children's primary educators and schools overstep when they teach contrary values; hold students accountable; promote STEM and spend on instructional quality (2022 school-board survey).
Says policy should rest on 'sound, perennial principles'; cites Crean and Fimister's 'Integralism: A Manual of Political Philosophy' and the Bible as key texts.
